findings.why: The only source on record for BR-310 is Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). No controlled record, such as an approved source list, covers Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B) for BR-310 at the receiving plant for Nordhavn Trucks (CUST-NOR). That means absence cannot be read as 'not approved'. A person must confirm whether SUP-B has a current release for this part, plant and customer. The supplier master lists SUP-B only for 'aluminium blanks and bars', not extrusions.
